title: Indus River flood near Sukkur
headline: Follow Sukkur, Sindh, Pakistan across 4 real radar observations
introduction: Pakistan's Flood Forecasting Division reported the Indus at medium flood level at the Guddu and Sukkur barrages at the end of July 2026; by 30 August Sukkur had receded to low flood.
conclusion: Follow the actual radar observations across the season. Differences are measured radar response, not proof of flooding. Independent flood evidence and classification limits remain applicable.

references.title: Dawn: Parts of Punjab, Sindh face urban flooding risk (1 Aug 2026)
PMD Flood Forecasting Division daily bulletin, 30 Aug 2026

method: NISAR, consistent polarization and orbit per story. Source calibrated power converted using 10*log10 where necessary; existing dB sources are not converted again. Bilinear alignment to the first grid, invalid/nonpositive power masked, fixed viridis −30 to +5 dB display. Statistics are radar response, not classified flood area.
